text_block_list.text:
There are many blessed individuals at 
Tracen Academy. Those who thrive in races 
are all gifted with immense talent or 
noble lineage.

The harsh reality. Even the friends who 
entered the academy alongside the spirited 
Katsuragi Ace have now abandoned the race 
entirely.

Katsuragi Ace fires herself up once more. 
She will run through her debut race and 
prove it to everyone: "We can do it too!"

The debut race draws near. Katsuragi Ace 
and her Trainer were about to take their 
very first step together!
